product_metadata.title: Assorted Dark Manor Frame Cutouts Decoration | 5 1/5" - 13" | 30 pcs.
features: PACKAGE INCLUDES: 30 Assorted Dark Manor Frame Cutouts Decoration which measures 5 1/5" to 13"
SPOOKY DESIGN: Comes in die-cut paper frames with a variety of horror themed images in assorted shapes and sizes all in vintage theme.
FOR HALLOWEEN: Mount these chilling decorations on walls or prop them up on flat surfaces to add a haunting element to your Halloween party decor.
DURABLE: These frames are lightweight made of printed cardstock shaped into vintage frames.

description: Set the mood for your creepy Halloween party with these Dark Manor themed picture frame cutouts.
